result: Independent follow-up passed the requested test/build commands. Own-account password validation now uses the authenticated account and updates its security stamp, so owner/admin/viewer flows are structurally correct; stale cookies should be rejected after password or role changes. Audit persistence failures now emit ILogger warnings. CSRF and authorization routing remain present. A remaining audit defect is that AuditAndAuthorizeMutationAsync records success whenever the handler returns normally, including 4xx/5xx IResult responses; owner-only account endpoint authorization failures are also outside that filter, so denied account mutations are not audited. UI account/audit screens remain absent as a separately expected follow-up.

evidence.outcome: Passed; Vite production build completed with existing SignalR Rollup annotation warnings.
POST /api/auth/password verifies current password against the uid/name account and changes that account password; security stamp is rotated by AccountService.ChangePasswordAsync.
OnValidatePrincipal loads uid account and rejects missing accounts or mismatched security_stamp claims.
AuditService catches persistence exceptions and calls logger.LogWarning without exposing secrets.

Viewer denied generic mutators are audited; successful handler completion is always labeled success, even when returned IResult indicates failure; owner group authorization occurs before its endpoint filters.
Unsafe auth/account routes retain CSRF filters; owner policy protects account and audit endpoints.
No account-management or audit-event UI screens are implemented.

next_slice.summary: Fix audit outcome classification based on returned HTTP status and add denied-audit coverage for owner-only account endpoints; optionally add focused integration tests for all three roles, stale cookies, and audit outcomes.

blockers: Mutation audit currently labels normal 4xx/5xx IResult responses as success.
Owner-only account authorization denials are not captured by the mutation audit filter.
Account/audit UI remains unimplemented follow-up work.
